announcements.title: Welcome to the new school year
announcements.body: Dear students and teachers, welcome back! Classes follow the weekly timetable in this portal. Please check your grades, attendance and homework here every day.

announcements.title: Parent-teacher meetings
announcements.body: Parent-teacher meetings for all classes take place at the end of the second quarter. Class teachers will share the exact times with families.

announcements.title: Mathematics olympiad registration is open
announcements.body: Students in grades 9 and 10 can register for the school mathematics olympiad with Ms. Rakhimova until the end of this month.

announcements.title: Quarter grading reminder
announcements.body: Teachers: please make sure every student has at least three grades per subject before the quarter closes. Quarter marks are calculated automatically from the grade book.

announcements.title: Library hours extended
announcements.body: The school library is now open until 17:00 on weekdays. New books for grades 9-10 have arrived.
